description: A logistics company in Norway and Denmark supplied 19,497 pairs of planned and actually driven last-mile delivery routes. The Data in Brief article says human dispatchers used heuristic planning tools, while 400 drivers completed the routes across 10,864 unique locations. The Mendeley Data release contains one public Excel workbook under CC BY 4.0. Each route is represented as a sequence of stops, with one row per stop and fields for route, driver and location identifiers, arrival timing, time windows and distances. The repository description says time values are relative to the earliest step in each route and distances use the Haversine formula. Coverage is one company’s deliveries in two countries, not a full road-network trace or a representative sample of all freight operators. Unpublished sampling dates, stop-level, not GPS-track representation and driver-selection effects are known limitations. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating deviation rules in agent-based delivery or route-optimisation simulations. model-sumo is a related traffic simulator, but its route input was not generated from this workbook. No XLSX rows were downloaded or checked.
